description:
Modding platform for GI, HSR, WW and ZZZ

Features
  One Ring — Allows to launch and manage all supported Model Importers in unified and convenient way
  Plug-and-Play — Configures any supported game and installs its XXMI instance automatically
  Custom Launch — Can be configured to start game in almost every possible way via Advanced Settings
  Automatic Updates — Always keeps XXMI instances and itself up-to date
  Safe to Use — Verifies authenticity of XXMI libraries and own downloads
Supported Model Importers
  WWMI - Wuthering Waves Model Importer GitHub
  ZZMI - Zenless Zone Zero Model Importer GitHub
  SRMI - Honkai: Star Rail Model Importer GitHub
  GIMI - Genshin Impact Model Importer GitHubs
**Available Editions** ([Installation Guide](https://github.com/SpectrumQT/XXMI-Launcher?tab=readme-ov-file#installation)):
• For **Native Windows App** mode download `.msi` installer.
• For **Portable** **or** **Linux** setup download `.zip` version.

[![Support on Patreon](https://img.shields.io/badge/Support-PATREON-orange?logo=patreon&logoColor=white)](https://www.patreon.com/SpectrumQT)

## Additions
• **[EFMI]:** Experimental workaround for **Direct Game Launch** for **GRYPHLINK** and **EGS** installations of **Endfield** (kudos to [Gustav0](https://github.com/Seris0) for research).
• **[EFMI]:** Added support for **Steam Game Launch** for **Endfield**.
• **[GUI]:** Added user-friendly status messages for the game startup step in the launch sequence.

## Adjustments
• **[GUI]:** Enabled display of XXMI DLL-specific settings when using a non-XXMI DLL.
    • Options requiring **XXMI DLL v1.2.0+** are now disabled (greyed out), with an explanatory warning in the tooltip.
    • Options introduced in earlier versions of XXMI DLL remain enabled, but display a warning in the tooltip.

## Bugfixes
• **[Launcher]:** Fixed an issue where game window wait timeout error was not triggering if the game process started successfully.
